_note: July-2 operator-approved dual Bank Builder — STRONGER 4-leg team-market lanes (user-directed). Lane A is a SAFETY-FIRST ladder step (four 72-81% protection/result legs, no coin-flip, no player props); its combined price is BELOW the aggressive Step-2 rung target on purpose — we prefer a safe lower-payout step over adding a coin-flip to chase payout. 'To advance' is not a market The Odds API offers for these fixtures, so Double Chance (team or draw, 90') is used as the honest advancement proxy and labeled as such. Over 1.5 totals are a real market but need a settlement-line change to grade at 1.5 (not the default 2.5), so protection markets — which are actually SAFER than Spain Over 1.5's 79% — were used instead. All odds are real de-vigged prices (betrivers) from the July-2 slate. Paper-only; canonical money moves only through official settlement.

lanes.label: Lane A · Survival (safety-first ladder step)
lanes.whyLadderPick: Four of the safest real team markets on the slate — Spain to win (75%) plus three protection legs (Portugal or Draw 81%, Switzerland or Draw 76%, Portugal draw-no-bet 72%). No coin-flip, no player props, no ultra-juiced meaningless leg. Double Chance is the honest 90' proxy for 'to advance' (that market isn't offered). Combined +133 is BELOW the Step-2 rung target on purpose: a safety-first step beats chasing payout with a coin-flip.
lanes.whyItCouldFail: It is still a 4-leg parlay: any one of Austria, Croatia beating Portugal outright, or Algeria springing an upset drops the card. The protection (double chance / draw-no-bet) legs survive a draw, but not an outright underdog win.

lanes.label: Lane B · Value
lanes.whyLadderPick: Four real team markets with more upside than Lane A: Portugal to win (53%), Switzerland draw-no-bet (66%), plus two model-aligned totals — Spain Over 2.5 (Spain's over lean, 51%) and Portugal Under 2.5 (Portugal's under lean, 56%). No player props, no contradictions (each total matches its game's score lean).
lanes.whyItCouldFail: Higher variance by design: Portugal only needs to not-win for the ML leg to fail, and either total missing its line kills the card. This is the swing-for-more lane, not the survival lane.
